headline: Jamal Murray Torches Nova Knicks For 42
subhead: White Mambas won the night 8-2 behind Murray's 8 threes, while Brandon Miller needed 29 shots to get 34.

zingers.line: Nova Knicks lost the night 8-2 to White Mambas as Jamal Murray dropped 42 and 8 threes on their heads.
Brandon Miller shot 10 for 29 with 5 turnovers, and Suggs to be you still trails MONSTARS ☄️ 7-4.
Jalen Johnson dished 16 assists and MONSTARS ☄️ still lost the night 8-3 because Aaron Gordon shot 2 for 9.
James Harden went 1 for 8 from the field, and Acinonyx dropped the night 6-5 to Zero Fox Given.
Zero Fox Given posted the worst night of anyone, Myles Turner went 0 for 4, and still won it 6-5.
Nikola Jokić put up 35, 15 and 10, and BrookynDynasty still lost the night 6-3 to Gopher Gold.
Anthony Davis shot 8 for 21, and LeParth James could only tie Thug Life 5-5 on the night.

night: Nikola Jokić posted 35 points, 15 rebounds and 10 assists for BrookynDynasty, the best line of the night, and BrookynDynasty still lost it 6-3.
Brandon Miller went 10 for 29 with 5 turnovers for Suggs to be you, the worst brick of the night, sinking their FG% and TO.
Jamal Murray hit 8 threes and scored 42 for White Mambas, who took the night 8-2 off Nova Knicks.
Justin Champagnie grabbed 14 rebounds with 11 points and is still sitting on the wire while all twelve teams look the other way.
Zero Fox Given had the worst night in the league, Myles Turner went 0 for 4, and they still beat Acinonyx 6-5.
